notes: The accounts of the Wazuh indexer that this repository holds (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Accounts'). Step 1 (scripts/accounts.py) makes each role, each user and each role mapping here, changes one when it differs, and deletes one that carries its mark when this file no longer has it. It never touches a reserved, hidden or static resource, a user that the upstream manifests make, or the account user it runs as. Each name starts with tnwks-.

No password and no hash is in this file. Step 1 sets the hash of each user from the Secret wazuh-accounts-hashes (one key for each user). The password of a user is only in the Secret of the part that logs in with it: tnwks-settings in wazuh-settings-user (step 2), tnwks-converter in wazuh-converter-reader (the converter).
A change of this file makes a new Job of step 1: the name of the Job carries a hash of this file and of the scripts of step 1 (security/tests/test_wazuh_settings.py checks it).

tnwks-converter reads the index names of the contract (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Contract'). On the agent snapshots it reads only the fields of the agent list (field-level security), not the host address, the system or the groups. It reads the size of each index of Wazuh from the index stats, which show no content.

tnwks-settings.description: Step 2: the ISM policies of tnwks (the five ISM actions of the script: policy get and write, managed index add, change and explain; index-management 3.6.0.0, transport/action/*/*Action.kt), the move of the indices of their streams to them, the raw events setting (the Setup plugin writes its document in .wazuh-settings with the rights of the caller, as a bulk request: the cluster action indices:data/write/bulk and the index actions on .wazuh-settings), and the document count of the streams that hold none. ISM runs the steps of each policy of tnwks with the roles of the user that wrote and moved it (index-management 3.6.0.0, ManagedIndexRunner), so this role also holds what those steps call: the index stats and the rollover on the names of the four streams, and the index stats and the delete on their backing indices. So this role can roll over and delete the indices of the four streams. No Security API. The findings monitors can search only their timestamp, rule identifier and severity fields.

tnwks-converter.description: The converter: the state of SCA and vulnerabilities, the agent list, the state of the content feed, and the size of each index of Wazuh. No event, no inventory, no file integrity.
